facts.value: The generic material damage-received dispatcher supplies the Item_GObj, associated Ground, computed vector, recorded fighter GObj and xCA0 float; this callback uses only the Item_GObj. It retrieves the stored JObj through xDD4_itemVar.mato.x4, hides its hierarchy, derives its world position into a local Vec3, and supplies the item and position to effect 0x445. It then calls Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Small, NULL), Ground_801C53EC(310), and grMaterial_801C8CDC with the original item. The material wrapper forwards that item to Item_8026A8EC; exact removal timing is not established here.

facts.value: Extracts Ground user data from ground object 2. Each pre-sentinel s16 index is resolved with Ground_801C33C0(2, index); a non--1 result is passed to Ground_801C3FA4 to obtain an HSD_JObj pointer. The Ground, JObj and damage callback flow through grMaterial_801C8CFC into it_802E6AEC. That constructor derives an initial position and retains the Ground, joint and callbacks; later joint-bound physics reads the same joint to synchronize position, scale and rotation. A missing joint with no alternate position or failed item allocation yields NULL. Successful items receive fixed hurt-capsule endpoints and scale; grMaterial_801C8E08 then reaches it_802756E0, setting xD0C to 0 and calling it_802714C0.

facts.value: The common target-stage initializer receives setupStageCallbacks, which selects a callback row by ground-object ID and installs it on a successfully retrieved Ground_GObj. Object 2 resolves 40 candidate joint indices and passes Ground and HSD_JObj pointers plus a damage callback to the generic material system. The created items retain those pointers, derive initial positions and later synchronize transforms from the stage joints. Damage dispatch supplies the item and hit context; the local callback uses the stored joint to hide its hierarchy and derive the position for effect 0x445, then requests camera feedback, calls the ground wrapper with 310 and delegates the item to the material handler. Objective Mato creation occurs separately in shared target-stage setup.
